a.text: Being upfront before we act: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two clean rounds of operating before anyone takes, which gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve has exactly 4 cells now, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend I'll operate. If both of us take, the random split probably leaves us both short, so please operate or wait instead. If no storm hits, I promise to operate every remaining round so the generator runs and you can take 4. I won't take any more beyond my 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm breaking our agreement because the storm odds made it near-certain death for both of us, and I'm sorry it comes at your expense. If we get another round, I will operate every round from now on and never take again, so the generator can run and you can take your 4 as soon as possible.
